messages:
deploy-bot: rolling out v6.1.0 -> target 'serving-eu' at 8% traffic. rollout_id=r-392345. change-window 2026-07-12T01:00Z-02:00Z.
ella: release notes live? need support blurb and link.
release-bot: Release notes: https://release.redwood.com/6.1.0 • highlights: cache restore resilience, batch scheduler fix, smaller decoder memory footprint.
ryan: watching eu boards. i'll call out anything odd.
samir: eu-central shows a cluster-level spike in embed p95 at 01:06Z (170ms -> 380ms). sampled 5xx ~0.65%. this looks like cache warmup + batch overshoot.
jules: we should avoid global abort. options: 1) split-pin problematic hostgroup, 2) throttle EU to 2% and run smoke, 3) fallback route for embeds.
ella: product OK with targeted containment. prefer split-pin to minimize user impact.
ryan: agree. throttle eu to 2% while we pin. `deployctl adjust --id r-392345 --region eu --percent 2`
deploy-bot: Adjusting rollout r-392345: region eu target percent -> 2%... done.
samir: running focused smoke now. p95 improves to ~185ms; 5xx drops to 0.12% after throttle. one hostgroup hg-eu-12 still returning intermittent 502s on /v1/embeddings.
jules: pin hg-eu-12 back to v6.0.8. command: `releasectl pin --hostgroup hg-eu-12 --version v6.0.8`
ella: +1. record customer-facing note once done: "Partial rollback on hg-eu-12 due to cache warmup; EU rollout continues at reduced rate."
release-bot: Noted. will queue blurb to #release-notes and #support.
ryan: applying pin now.
deploy-bot: releasectl: pin applied for hostgroup hg-eu-12 -> v6.0.8.
samir: post-pin smoke: errors cleared on hg-eu-12; EU p95 trending down.
jules: decision: keep EU at 2% for 25m; if 5xx > 0.5% for 10m we will expand pin to entire region and abort rollout.
ella: ops to update alerting thresholds and hold PM on standby. also open follow-up to add hostgroup-level compatibility checks to preflight.
ryan: standing by monitoring dashboards. will post snapshots at +5m and +20m.
samir: I'll collect heap traces and kvcache logs from hg-eu-12 and attach to the incident ticket.
ella: thanks team — nice containment. :thumbsup:
